title: 2015: DOM XSS Scanner
description: Student Hall of Fame entry for 2015 Summer GSoC: DOM XSS Scanner by Aabha Biyani

chapters.title: DOM XSS Scanner
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame credits Aabha Biyani with the DOM XSS Scanner (2015 Summer, directly mentored). The add-on's first commit in zap-extensions, "DOM XSS Active Scan rule", is dated 2015-08-21 and was made by psiinon (Simon Bennetts), so the code reached the repository through a core-team member.
